newsitem.title: USA: Sytje's Pannekoeken Huis files for liquidation.
newsitem.headline: Sytje's Pannekoeken Huis files for liquidation.

text.p: Styje's Pannekoeken Huis Restaurants Inc said Monday it filed to convert its pending Chapter 11 reorganization into a Chapter 7 liquidation proceeding under the Bankruptcy Code.
It said operations at franchised stores in Long Lake, Maplewood and Rochester, Minn. were not affecdted by this action.
President Todd Novaczyk said "Despite our significant efforts over the past seven months to reorganize the company and recapitalize it, the business continued to deteriorate throughout the summer."
He added in a statement that "cash flows are now insufficient to allow for recovery."
